title: City of Waterloo ends Significant Weather Event at 3 p.m. January 30, 2026
body:
City of Waterloo ends Significant Weather Event at 3 p.m. January 30, 2026
By
City of Waterloo
-
Jan 30, 2026
City news
Service alerts
The City of Waterloo's current Significant Weather Event will end as of 3 p.m. today (Friday). Snow loading crews have been able to address sight-line concerns at major intersections across the City.
Residents are encouraged to subscribe to the City’s
newsfeed
or check the City website for future updates.
For more information about the City’s snow clearing priorities for roads and sidewalks, and tips for driving and parking when plows are active, visit
waterloo.ca/snow
.
